relationships.kurono-shinguji: Longtime rival and emotionally central partner; catches Kurono and receives her promise to return for their unresolved summer.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Former trainee; returns with her from Vermillion and entrusts the final Tokyo strike to her.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Returns alongside him from the Vermillion aftermath.

periods.summary: Nene returns from Vermillion at the decisive moment of the Tokyo battle. She rides a meteor created by Hadou Tensei straight into Enterprise, crippling the massive Device before it can fire again. She then catches the exhausted and bleeding Kurono as she falls, initially panicking at Kurono's injuries but regaining composure when Kurono promises she will come back to settle their old summer. Nene leaves the rest of the war to the arriving students and knights, including Stella and Ikki.

key_events.summary: Drops a meteor on Enterprise and catches Kurono.
